orgs.name: 도봉구육아종합지원센터
orgs.status: ok (program detail/booking pages require 개인회원 login)
orgs.howToCollect: Homepage verified at https://www.doccic.go.kr/ (redirects to /main/). Monthly program calendar (plain GET, server-rendered): /study/center_all.php?yyyy=YYYY&mm=MM (tabs: center_1.php=방학센터, center_2.php=창동센터, center_3.php=기타놀이실 e.g. 도봉1동실내놀이터/놀이누림터, center_4.php=부모양육상담; care2.php = 어린이집(기관) programs, excluded). Calendar cells give only title + time + link /study/center_view.php?idx=N&e_type=education1(방학)|education2(창동)|etc, and center_view.php returns alert('개인회원만 신청 가능합니다.') without login. Full details (target, fee tiers, capacity) come from the monthly flyer images posted on 센터소식 /community/news.php (e.g. '[가정양육지원/공통] 2026년 10월 영유아 및 부모대상 프로그램 안내' idx=574, '2026년 10월 부모-자녀체험활동 안내' idx=575, '제15회 도담도담놀이터 안내' idx=578); image text was read manually (no OCR library), so re-check before reuse. Flyer day numbers ('16일') are October 2026 per the flyer header '2026년 10월'. fee = 도봉구민 rate (lowest tier); all tiers are in feeText. capacity = per class/time slot as printed (null when not printed). applyStart 2026-09-28 = '10월 프로그램 예약 9월 28일(월) 10시' (11월 프로그램: 공지 10월 20일, 예약 10월 25일(일) 10시 — November calendar was still empty on 2026-10-13). Excluded: packages that started before 10/13 ([3주패키지] 발도르프 습식수채화 10/13~27, [3주패키지] 아장요리 10/7~21, [2주패키지] 빵빵요리 10/7~14, [2주패키지] 아장도예 10/14~21) to stay within 15 items; 다같이多가치 전래놀이 (10/10 only, past); drop-in 놀이누림터/도봉1동실내놀이터 sessions; 장난감 대여 and 서울형 키즈카페 (services, not dated programs). Note: the calendar shows 24절기 only on 10/10 while the flyer lists 10일 and 17일.

orgs.name: 도봉구 가족센터
orgs.howToCollect: List (GET, server-rendered, 5 per page, 'rows' param ignored): .../recruitReceipt/list.do?rows=5&cpage=N (35 programs, all '접수중' on 2026-10-13). Each item: send('<seq>',...) → detail page .../recruitReceipt/view.do?seq=<seq> (GET-openable but content is filled by JS). Detail JSON: POST https://dobong.familynet.or.kr/recruitReceipt/getView.do with JSON body {"seq":"<seq>"}, Content-Type application/json, header X-CSRF-TOKEN = <meta name="_csrf"> from the view page, and the same JSESSIONID cookie (403 without them). Fields: participation_target, program_start_date/program_end_date, reception_date_start_time/end_time, program_place1/2, program_conts, program_status_nm, main_episode, episode[] (title, episode_dt), recruit_personal (+ recruit_personal_yn; capacity is hidden on the site when 'N', so capacity was set null in that case), recruit_unit RCRTT00001=명 / RCRTT00002=가정. No fee field exists → fee null. Excluded: 한국어교육, 1인가구, 결혼이민자 취업, 한부모 자조모임 (adult), 이중언어 직접교육 (target not stated), 다문화나눔봉사단/전통춤동아리 (adult).

orgs.name: 시립창동청소년센터
orgs.howToCollect: Site title is now '시립창동청소년센터' (formerly 창동청소년수련관). Notices: /sub06/sub01.php?mode=read&id=N (GET). Monthly 교육문화프로그램 newsletter is posted as 2 images (e.g. id=5834 '26년 11월 평생교육 월간소식지'); text was read manually from the images. Year 2026 taken from the newsletter header '2026년 11월 시립창동청소년센터 교육문화프로그램'. NOTE: several Saturday classes are printed as '11/10개강' but 2026-11-10 is a Tuesday (2026-11-07 is the first Saturday) — dates kept as printed; verify. Online booking is via http://online140.youth.seoul.kr/?center_id=140 (login). Only classes whose 대상 includes ages ≤ 13 were kept (piano/violin/guitar/drum classes mixing teens and adults, 보컬마스터, 한우리 독서/한국사/독해, 마인크래프트/로블록스, 캔바&AI, 글쓰기&논술, 자신감 쑥쑥 영어회화 etc. were left out to stay within 15). '만' ages 6~12 were tagged elem-low/elem-high.
